resources.string: One tap to scan a document into Google Drive.

Shows the QwiKScan floating bubble on top of other apps. Tap the bubble to open Google Drive\'s document scanner, from any screen.\n\nQwiKScan uses this access only to draw the bubble and open Drive for you. It does not read what is on your screen, see what you type, or collect any data. Your scans go to Google Drive, not to QwiKScan.
Scan a document to Google Drive
Showing. Tap it over any app to open Drive\'s scanner.
Opens Google Drive\'s document scanner. Scans save to your Step 3 folder, or Drive asks where.
